references.text: In Luke 18:38-42 we find a parallel account where a blind man asks Jesus to restore his sight, similar to the one in Mark 10:51.
Mark 8:22-25 describes another event where Jesus heals a blind man, demonstrating Jesus' power to give sight to the blind, as seen in Mark 10:51.

In John 9:1-7 Jesus heals a man born blind by applying mud to his eyes and telling him to wash in the Pool of Siloam, showing Jesus' ability to perform miracles for the blind, similar to the event in Mark 10:51.
